name: preferences.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  preferences.scss — the preferences dialog: genie-zoom panel (--genie-x/y
//  origin), theme slider track + WebGL canvas, preference switch rows, and
//  the dev-tools NPU analytics block. Layered above the nav menu overlay.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';
@import '../../base/fonts';
@import '../../base/placeholders';
@import '../../base/structure';

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Preferences Modal Dialog
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

:host {
  display: none;
}

:host([open]),
:host(.is-open) {
  display: block;
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 10000;
  width: 100vw;
  height: 100vh;
  height: 100dvh;
}

// Backdrop: fullscreen dim/blur layer behind the dialog; the genie zoom uses --genie-x/y as transform origin.
.pref-backdrop {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  z-index: 10000;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  // Simple uniform padding — box-sizing:border-box ensures width:100% accounts
  // for this padding so the dialog always fits within the viewport and
  // flexbox centering works symmetrically on all viewport sizes.
  padding: to-rem($space-xl);
  // Light veil: the menu animation behind must stay readable
  background: rgba($color-black, 0.28);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
  backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
  outline: none;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: opacity 0.55s ease;

  // Genie: the dialog zooms from / to the control that opened it.
  // transform-origin is set inline (--genie-x/--genie-y, relative to the dialog box).
  &--enter,
  &--leave {
    opacity: 0;
  }

  &--enter .pref-dialog,
  &--leave .pref-dialog {
    transform: scale(0.04) translateY(to-rem($space-xl));
    opacity: 0;
    filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
  }

  &--leave,
  &--leave .pref-dialog {
    pointer-events: none;
  }
}

// The dialog card itself — scales from its trigger point via the genie custom properties.
.pref-dialog {
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  // The backdrop padding constrains the width to grid; 610px cap prevents
  // the dialog from stretching too wide on large viewports.
  max-width: to-rem($space-8xl);
  max-height: calc(88vh);
  max-height: calc(88dvh);
  background: var(--bg-primary);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  border: to-rem(1) solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: to-rem($space-xl);
  box-shadow: 0 to-rem(24) to-rem(48) to-rem(-12) rgba($color-black, 0.35);
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  transform-origin: var(--genie-x, 50%) var(--genie-y, 50%);
  will-change: transform, opacity;
  transition:
    transform 0.72s cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1),
    opacity 0.48s cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1),
    filter 0.6s ease;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .pref-backdrop,
  .pref-dialog {
    transition: none;
  }
}

// Dialog top row: title + circular close button.
.pref-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: to-rem($space-xl) to-rem($space-2xl);
  border-bottom: to-rem(1) solid var(--border-color);
}

// Dialog heading.
.pref-title {
  @extend .ttl-sm;

  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: to-rem(-0.2);
  color: inherit;
}

$_B_PREF_CLOSE: 'pref-close';

// Circular close button (WebGL X canvas inside).
.#{$_B_PREF_CLOSE}-btn {
  @extend %RESETBTN;

  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: to-rem($space-3xl);
  height: to-rem($space-3xl);
  border-radius: var(--radius-round);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  background: var(--border-color);
  transition:
    background 0.2s ease,
    transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;

  // WebGL Canvas
  .#{$_B_PREF_CLOSE}-canvas {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: var(--radius-round);
    display: block;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .#{$_B_PREF_CLOSE}-canvas.is-fallback {
    display: none;
  }

  // CSS-drawn X via pseudo-elements: canvas absent or WebGL unavailable
  &:not(:has(.#{$_B_PREF_CLOSE}-canvas)),
  &:has(.#{$_B_PREF_CLOSE}-canvas.is-fallback) {
    &::before,
    &::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      width: to-rem($space-xl);
      height: to-rem($space-hairline + 1);
      background: var(--text-secondary);
      border-radius: var(--radius-round);
      transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    }

    &::before {
      transform: rotate(45deg);
    }
    &::after {
      transform: rotate(-45deg);
    }

    &:hover,
    &:focus {
      background: var(--border-color-hover, var(--border-color));

      &::before {
        transform: rotate(135deg);
      }
      &::after {
        transform: rotate(45deg);
      }
    }
  }
}

// Scrollable content area of the dialog.
.pref-body {
  flex: 1; // Fill remaining space in the flex-column dialog
  min-height: 0; // Allow shrinking so overflow-y:auto actually scrolls
  padding: to-rem($space-2xl);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: to-rem($space-3xl);
  overflow-y: auto;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;

  // Scrollbar — themed to match modal dialog background
  scrollbar-color: var(--border-color) transparent;
  scrollbar-width: thin;

  &::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: to-rem($space-xs);
  }

  &::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: transparent;
  }

  &::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: var(--border-color);
    border-radius: var(--radius-round);
  }
}

// A settings group (theme, switches, dev tools).
.pref-section {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: to-rem($space-md);
}

// Group heading.
.pref-section-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: to-rem(18);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: to-rem(0.8);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

// Group helper text.
.pref-section-desc {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: to-rem(15);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

// Grid of selectable options.
.pref-options {
  display: grid;
  gap: to-rem($space-md);
  position: relative;

  &--4 {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);

    @media (max-width: $bk-540) {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    }
  }

  &--3 {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  }

  &--2 {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
}

// Moving glass highlight that follows selection in the language grid.
.lang-glass-follower {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
  border: to-rem($space-hairline) solid var(--border-color);
  background: transparent;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-featured);
  transition:
    transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1),
    width 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1),
    height 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1),
    opacity 0.2s ease;
  z-index: 2;
  opacity: 0;
}

// Language dialog variant (shared shell with pref).
.lang-dialog {
  // 480px cap on wide screens; on narrow screens the backdrop padding
  // already constrains width, so max-width: 100% lets it fill the grid.
  max-width: min(to-rem(480), 100%);
}

// Theme slider block (canvas + labels + fallback buttons).
.pref-theme-wrapper {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: to-rem($space-md);
  width: 100%;
}

// Slider row: WebGL canvas with the light/system/dark stops.
.pref-theme-slider {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  width: 100%;
  cursor: pointer;
  touch-action: none;
}

// The WebGL theme slider canvas.
.pref-theme-canvas {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  height: to-rem(64);
  border-radius: to-rem(32);
  display: block;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);

  &:hover,
  &:focus-visible {
    transform: scale(1.01);
  }

  &:active {
    transform: scale(0.99);
  }
}

// light / system / dark labels under the slider.
.pref-theme-labels {
  display: none;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: to-rem($space-sm);
  width: 100%;
}

.pref-theme-wrapper.has-fallback .pref-theme-labels,
.pref-theme-slider:not(:has(.pref-theme-canvas:not(.is-fallback):not([style*='display: none'])))
  + .pref-theme-labels {
  display: grid;
}

// Fallback theme buttons when the canvas can't render.
.pref-theme-btn {
  @extend %RESETBTN;

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: to-rem($space-xs);
  padding: to-rem($space-sm) to-rem($space-md);
  background: var(--bg-secondary);
  border: to-rem($space-hairline) solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: to-rem($space-md);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
  font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);

  &:hover,
  &:focus-visible {
    border-color: var(--text-muted);
    background: var(--bg-primary);
  }

  &--active {
    border-color: var(--text-primary);
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    box-shadow: 0 to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-sm) rgba($color-black, 0.08);
  }
}

// One selectable preference option (language/grid/etc).
.pref-option-btn {
  @extend %RESETBTN;

  position: relative;
  overflow: visible;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: to-rem($space-xs);
  padding: to-rem($space-xl) to-rem($space-sm);
  background: var(--bg-secondary);
  border: to-rem(2) solid transparent;
  border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1),
    border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    filter 0.2s ease;

  &::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: var(--btn-accent-fill);
    border-radius: inherit;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
  }

  > * {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
  }

  &:hover,
  &:focus-visible {
    border-color: var(--text-muted);
    transform: translateY(to-rem(-$space-3xs)) scale(1.03);

    &::before {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    > * {
      transform: scale(1.04);
    }
  }

  &.active {
    border-color: var(--text-primary);
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  }
}

// Small stat card inside the dev-tools analytics block.
.pref-stat-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: to-rem($space-2xs);
  padding: to-rem($space-lg) to-rem($space-sm);
  background: var(--bg-secondary);
  border: to-rem(1) solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  text-align: center;
}

$_B_FLAG: 'flag';

// Icon inside an option button.
.pref-option-icon {
  font-size: to-rem($space-2xl);
  line-height: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

  &:has(.#{$_B_FLAG}-canvas:not(.is-fallback):not([style*='display: none'])) {
    .#{$_B_FLAG}-img,
    .#{$_B_FLAG}-split {
      display: none;
    }
  }

  // Show SVG images when WebGL canvas has fallback
  &:has(.#{$_B_FLAG}-canvas.is-fallback) {
    .#{$_B_FLAG}-img,
    .#{$_B_FLAG}-split {
      display: block;
    }
  }
}

// Flag images & WebGL Canvas — SVG from local repo
.#{$_B_FLAG}-img {
  height: to-rem(44);
  width: auto;
  display: block;
  border-radius: to-rem(3);
  box-shadow: 0 to-rem($space-hairline) to-rem($space-xs) rgba($color-black, 0.25);
}

// Flag WebGL canvas in the language options.
.#{$_B_FLAG}-canvas {
  height: to-rem(44);
  width: auto;
  display: block;
  border-radius: to-rem(3);
  box-shadow: 0 to-rem($space-hairline) to-rem($space-xs) rgba($color-black, 0.25);
  pointer-events: none;
}

// Split flag: two country flags side by side with a thin dividing line
.flag-split {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0;
  position: relative;

  .flag-img {
    height: to-rem(44);
    width: to-rem(33); // force equal width so both flags share space evenly
    object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: 0;

    &:first-child {
      border-radius: to-rem(3) 0 0 to-rem(3);
      object-position: left center;
    }
    &:last-child {
      border-radius: 0 to-rem(3) to-rem(3) 0;
      object-position: right center;
    }
  }
}

// Option label text.
.pref-option-label {
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: to-rem(16);
}

// Option sub-label (locale name/description).
.pref-option-sub {
  font-size: to-rem(13);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

// ─── Toggle Switch ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Single row with label on left, iOS-style switch pill on right.
// Replaces 2-button pattern for binary on/off toggles.

$_B_SW: 'pref-switch';
$_SW_W: 52; // switch pill width
$_SW_H: 28; // switch pill height
$_SW_KNOB: 22; // knob diameter
$_SW_PAD: 3; // padding inside pill

// One switch row (label + description + WebGL toggle).
.#{$_B_SW}-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: to-rem($space-md);
  padding: to-rem($space-sm) 0;
  border-bottom: to-rem(1) solid var(--border-color);
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;

  &:last-child {
    border-bottom: none;
  }
}

// Text side of a switch row.
.#{$_B_SW}-info {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: to-rem($space-2xs);
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

// Switch row label.
.#{$_B_SW}-label {
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: to-rem(15);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

// Switch row description.
.#{$_B_SW}-desc {
  font-size: to-rem(13);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  line-height: 1.4;
}

// The WebGL switch canvas (pill track + knob).
.#{$_B_SW} {
  // The pill track
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: to-rem($_SW_W);
  height: to-rem($_SW_H);
  background: var(--border-color);
  border-radius: var(--radius-round);
  position: relative;
  transition: background 0.2s ease;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 0;
  border: none;
  overflow: hidden;

  &-canvas {
    width: to-rem($_SW_W);
    height: to-rem($_SW_H);
    border-radius: var(--radius-round);
    display: block;
    pointer-events: none;

    &.is-fallback {
      display: none;
    }
  }

  &:has(.#{$_B_SW}-canvas:not(.is-fallback):not([style*='display: none'])) {
    background: transparent;
  }

  // Fallback CSS knob when canvas has is-fallback class
  &:has(.#{$_B_SW}-canvas.is-fallback) {
    &::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: to-rem($_SW_PAD);
      left: to-rem($_SW_PAD);
      width: to-rem($_SW_KNOB);
      height: to-rem($_SW_KNOB);
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--color-white-raw);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
      transition:
        transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
        background 0.2s ease;
    }

    &.#{$_B_SW}--on::after {
      transform: translateX(to-rem($_SW_W - $_SW_KNOB - $_SW_PAD * 2));
      background: var(--bg-darkest);
    }
  }

  // ON state
  &--on {
    background: var(--color-accent);
  }
}

// Dialog footer: done button row.
.pref-footer {
  padding: to-rem($space-lg) to-rem($space-2xl);
  border-top: to-rem(1) solid var(--border-color);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
}

// Done/close button at the bottom.
.pref-done-btn {
  @extend %RESETBTN;
  @extend .ttl-xs;

  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  padding: to-rem($space-sm) to-rem($space-2xl); // taller + wider for all lang labels
  min-width: to-rem(160); // never squishes in DE/PT/ES
  margin-top: to-rem($space-lg); // breathing room above
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background: transparent;
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: to-rem(1);
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition:
    color 0.2s ease,
    opacity 0.2s ease;

  // Animated corner borders (same style & animation as Check Out button)
  &::before,
  &::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: to-rem($space-md);
    height: to-rem($space-md);
    transition:
      width 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      height 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  }

  &::before {
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    border-top: to-rem(1) solid var(--text-primary);
    border-left: to-rem(1) solid var(--text-primary);
  }

  &::after {
    bottom: 0;
    right: 0;
    border-bottom: to-rem(1) solid var(--text-primary);
    border-right: to-rem(1) solid var(--text-primary);
  }

  &:hover,
  &:focus {
    color: var(--text-primary);
    opacity: 0.85;

    &::before,
    &::after {
      width: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-2xs)});
      height: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-2xs)});
    }
  }
}

// Vue modal transition
.pref-fade-enter-active,
.pref-fade-leave-active {
  transition: opacity 0.25s ease;
}
.pref-fade-enter-active .pref-dialog,
.pref-fade-leave-active .pref-dialog {
  transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}
.pref-fade-enter-from,
.pref-fade-leave-to {
  opacity: 0;
}
.pref-fade-enter-from .pref-dialog,
.pref-fade-leave-to .pref-dialog {
  transform: scale(0.94);
}
